# Stylelint drops stylistic formatting rules while retaining logical-property enforcement

The assigned configuration removes @stylistic/stylelint-plugin and its six explicit formatting rules. It retains stylelint-use-logical and csstools/use-logical:always, keeping the logical-property check separate from formatting. The author reports Prettier coverage, but static configuration inspection does not prove identical formatter results or diagnostics.

Scope: tooling/stylelint-prettier-boundary.
